C# · .NET 10 · WIN2D

Native diagrams for Windows.

Requirements

Render a diagram

using NornaKit;
using NornaKit.Windows;

var renderer = WindowsDiagramRenderer.Create();
var artifact = await renderer.RenderAsync(
    "flowchart LR\n A[Source] --> B[Native diagram]",
    new DiagramLayoutOptions(MaxWidth: 640));
var svg = SvgExporter.Export(artifact.Scene, WindowsPalette.Resolve());
